text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — eu-west canary showing increased 5xx rate after rollout v2.3.4. Severity: P1. Spike started ~2176543200. Affected route: /api/v1/generate. Error rate ~12% (baseline 0.3%).

emma: ack'ing. I'm on it — pulling logs and rolling back if we see clear regression. tagging @deepak for routing fallback.

deepak: oncall pinged. can we divert traffic to previous shard set? I can flip traffic-steer in ~30s if needed.

liam: noticed increased tail latency on the canary hosts, also OOM-ish traces in the logs for one pod. posting snippet:
```
2026-03-12T14:13:22Z ERROR inference: runtime aborted: alloc failed: out of memory
stack: ...
```

maria: rolling redeploys just started in eu-west at 14:10 UTC, we pushed quantized kernel changes in this build. :grimacing:

emma: ok, mitigation plan: 1) enable feature flag kill for v2 routing to stop new sessions on canary (fflag:route_v2=false), 2) divert traffic to stable pool, 3) rollback image if needed.

deepak: doing step 1 now — hitting the flag API.

deepak: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" https://flags.internal/route_v2/disable` -> 202 accepted. @emma can you confirm traffic started flowing?

emma: seeing drop in new sessions to canary in the dashboard. routing steer reports changed from 10% -> 0% in 45s. :thumbsup:

liam: still seeing error bursts on existing canary sessions (KV cache thrash), but no new sessions. I'll start a controlled drain of the problematic pods.

maria: starting pod drain: `kubectl cordon && kubectl drain` on canary pool eu-west-2b.

ops-sre: customer impact check: SLO hit window looks like ~2.5 minutes of elevated 5xx affecting ~0.15% of overall customer requests (mostly short generations). No major customers reported yet. raising support ticket for any manual reports.

emma: after drain and traffic-steer, overall 5xx back to baseline. I'm going to mark rollout paused. We should not resume v2 in eu until kernel patch verified.

deepak: creating incident ticket INC-2026-3287 with timeline and mitigation steps. linking to runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/deploy-failure

liam: forensics: reproducer points to the new allocator path under heavy multi-stream workload. I'll open a PR to back out allocator change and add mem-safeguards.

maria: tagging release lead @sara — hold promo to other regions. We'll coordinate a canary re-test after PR.

emma: handing off to @deepak for overnight watch + monitoring until the PR merges. deepak — your pager window?

deepak: I have it, taking handoff. I'll keep alerts muted but will escalate on any recurrence. leaving summary in the ticket and posting a short blameless note.

oncall-bot: Auto-update — incident INC-2026-3287 created, severity set to P1 -> downgraded to P2 after mitigation. Next update scheduled in 30m.

ops-sre: moving to postmortem queue, please include root cause, mitigation timeline, and follow-ups (add memory pressure alarms, add safety net in allocator).
